    "content": "Game task-86c40637 is a two-object rotation/docking puzzle. Controls: 1=up, 2=down, 3=left, 4=right; each arrow translates the ACTIVE object by 3 pixels. Action 5 rotates the active object 90 degrees clockwise. Action 6 clicks the OTHER object's orange marker to activate that object and lock the first object cyan/e. Position and rotate both objects so the first object's two orange pegs meet the second object's matching pegs; successful connectors turn green and completion occurs on the final rotation. Demonstration routes: (1) move first object UP x2, RIGHT x4, click the second object's marker, then rotate second x3; (2) move first DOWN x2, LEFT x5, rotate first x3, click second, rotate second x1. Exact solved fresh layout: first black body x2-10,y23-37, right pegs x11-13 at y26-28 and y32-34; second e body x47-55,y26-45, right pegs x56-58 at y32-34 and y38-40. Solution in 27 actions: UP x4, RIGHT x20, ROTATE(5) x1, click (56,32), ROTATE(5) x3. This creates the required stacked alignment. Important failure: merely docking the unrotated objects side-by-side and then rotating/translating the second does not solve, even when some markers appear close or green; reset and use the stacked route above.\n\nSOLVED second fresh layout (2026-11-08): first black body x20-38,y17-25 with DOWN orange pegs x26-28 and32-34,y26-28; second cyan body x44-52,y23-36, side pegs at y26-28 and32-34, right orange marker centered (60,27). Exact 14-action solution: UP x2, RIGHT x7, click (60,27), ROTATE(5) x3, UP x1. After the translations the first body is x41-61,y11-19 and pegs x47-49/x53-55,y20-22. Rotating second x3 puts its orange pegs at x47-49/x53-55,y23-25. IMPORTANT: adjacency is NOT docking/completion; the final UP moves the active second object up 3 pixels so its pegs overlap the first object's pegs at y20-22, completing immediately. This clarifies prior notes: connectors must overlap, not merely touch or align next to each other.\n\nSOLVED third fresh layout (vertical first body x17-25,y20-40, left pegs; second body x34-49,y29-43, UP pegs x40-42/x46-48,y26-28): reset and use DOWN x2, LEFT x5, ROTATE x5 (first ends UP with pegs x8-10/x14-16,y26-28), click second marker (46,27), ROTATE x2 (second ends DOWN), LEFT x10, UP x5.
